---

## 1.0 Summary

<!-- synthesia-video-url: https://share.synthesia.io/a687df0a-06d6-4bda-b332-0dbf677bdffd | ../assets/images/synthesia/home-thumbnail.png -->

This document outlines Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture (EA) practice, defining the approach to creating, maintaining, and evolving the enterprise architecture that supports business objectives. It establishes the framework for how the organization governs and executes architectural initiatives.

---
page_texts.5:
[README.md#20-intended-audience]

## 2.0 Intended Audience

This repository is intended for:

- **Executive Leadership** - Strategic direction and oversight
- **Legal & Compliance** - Regulatory requirements and risk management
- **Sales & Marketing** - Market positioning and customer engagement
- **Enterprise Architects** - Reference patterns, standards, and governance frameworks
- **Solution Architects** - Architectural templates and decision records
- **Technical Architects** - Implementation guidelines and technology standards
- **Development Teams** - Approved patterns, APIs, and integration standards
- **Product Managers** - Understanding architectural constraints and capabilities
- **Platform Engineers** - Infrastructure patterns and deployment standards
- **Engineering Managers** - Architecture governance processes and review criteria
- **DevOps Teams** - CI/CD patterns and operational procedures
- **Security Teams** - Security frameworks and compliance requirements
- **Human Resources** - EA practice job descriptions and career development framework
- **New Team Members** - Onboarding materials and architectural context

[README.md#-cross-domain-integration]

### 🔗 Cross-Domain Integration

The repository structure supports seamless integration across domains:

- **Governance → Decisions**: Governance framework drives ADR processes
- **Principles → Standards**: Guiding principles inform standards development
- **Products → Standards**: Product documentation references enterprise standards
- **Strategy → Governance**: Strategic direction influences governance policies
- **Training → All Domains**: Training materials span all architecture areas

[README.md#quick-start-for-new-contributors]

#### Quick Start for New Contributors

1. **Environment Setup**: Follow the [onboarding guide](onboarding/README.md) to configure your development environment
   - **Mac Users**: Run `./onboarding/setup-mac.sh`
   - **Windows Users**: Run `./onboarding/setup-windows.ps1`

2. **IDE Configuration**: Pre-configured settings for:
   - Visual Studio Code (`onboarding/vscode/`)
   - Visual Studio (`onboarding/visualstudio/`)

3. **AI Tools**: Optional but recommended:
   - **Claude Code**: Review [.claude/CLAUDE.md](.claude/CLAUDE.md) for custom commands and workflows
   - **GitHub Copilot**: See [.copilot/](.copilot/) for integration guidance

---

[README.md#github-as-source-of-truth]

### GitHub as Source of Truth

This **GitHub repository** serves as the **single source of truth** for all Enterprise Architecture documentation and artifacts. All updates, changes, and version control happen here through established governance processes.
page_texts.26:
[README.md#mkdocs-community-publishing]

### MkDocs Community Publishing

Documentation is automatically published using **MkDocs** for broader organizational access and consumption:
page_texts.27:
[README.md#automated-publishing-process]

#### **Automated Publishing Process**

- **🆕 Enhanced GitHub Actions Workflow**: Automatically builds and deploys changes with comprehensive progress tracking
    - **Real-time Progress Monitoring**: Stage-by-stage deployment visibility with emoji indicators
    - **Deployment Timing**: Track deployment duration and provide ETA calculations
    - **File Processing Counters**: Monitor real-time file processing and upload progress
    - **AWS Step Tracking**: Detailed monitoring of Amplify deployment phases
- **Material Theme**: Professional presentation with Material Design for enhanced readability
- **Interactive Features**: Native support for Mermaid diagrams, code highlighting, and navigation
- **Link Processing**: Maintains GitHub markdown compatibility with optimized internal linking
- **Search Integration**: Full-text search across all documentation with instant results
- **Asset Optimization**: Processes images, diagrams, and other assets for web consumption

---

Contributions from all EA practice members and stakeholders are welcome. For detailed guidelines on how to contribute to this repository, please see the [Contributing Guidelines](foundation/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Quick Overview

- **Process**: Use GitHub Issues for suggestions, coordinate with Domain EA Leads for new content, template-based contribution system
- **Standards**: Follow governance guidelines and documentation standards
- **Review**: All contributions reviewed by EA Practice team
- **Scope**: Documentation, patterns, tools, templates, and process improvements

For complete contribution procedures, coding standards, and review processes, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](foundation/CONTRIBUTING.md).
